## About
Brighton Auto YP is an auto repair and maintenance shop on South Archer Avenue in Chicago. We work on all makes and models, from a routine oil change to complex engine work, and we'll explain what your car needs and what it costs before we start.
A reviewer calls us trustworthy, honest and very transparent, and another calls us a fair mechanic. A customer who misfueled his Mercedes Sprinter diesel says we got him back on the road the same day.
We're open Monday through Friday. Call the shop or use the online form to set up a visit.

## Services
- Brake Service: Brake inspections and repairs, from pads and rotors to fluid, calipers and lines.
- Oil Change: Synthetic or conventional oil, matched to your vehicle and how you drive.
- Battery Service: Battery testing, replacement and maintenance so it starts in every season.
- A/C Service and Repair: A/C repairs and recharge for the warm months.
- Vehicle Diagnostics: We track down what's wrong before we fix it.
- Engine Repair: Engine repair and rebuilding.
- Steering and Suspension: Steering and suspension repairs for the city's rough roads.
- Preventative Maintenance: Regular upkeep to keep your car ready for every season.

## FAQ
Q: Do you offer a warranty on repairs?
A: Yes. Our warranty covers all repair and maintenance work.

Q: How do I schedule an appointment?
A: Use the online contact form or call the shop directly.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: No. We're open Monday through Friday and closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Can I wait while you work on my car?
A: Yes. There's a waiting area with free Wi-Fi and complimentary beverages.
